source_note: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题
english_source_note: Criteria for Density of Sequences in an Interval
callout_id: 判断序列在区间内稠密的几个命题#13
statement_en: Let $f:[1,+\infty)$ be unbounded, and suppose its derivative satisfies $f'(x)>0$ and decreases to $0$. Then the sequence $f(n)$ is dense modulo $1$.
callout_body: 函数$f:[1,+\infty)$无界，其微分满足$f'(x)>0$并且$f'(x)$减少到0，那么序列$f(n)$模1稠密。
